illustration.description: Stylized anatomical x-ray-like rendering of a muscular male figure in a high plank position, side profile facing right, arms straight down to the floor with fists/forearms planted, legs extended straight back to bare toes. Body is dark near-black with glowing orange-yellow rim light and translucent muscle fibers. The spine is highlighted with glowing orange vertebrae along the back, and the lower abdominal core muscles are intensely glowing bright yellow-orange with a soft red-orange heat haze and faint concentric pulse rings around the midsection. Soft orange reflection on a white floor beneath the feet and hands. Clean white studio background, high-contrast medical-infographic style, realistic 3D render.
